purpose.zh: 练手臂后侧和胸，从低处把身体推起
purpose.en: Build the back of your arms and your chest by pressing up from low down.

text.zh: 下到上臂差不多和地面平行，再推起
text.en: Lower until your upper arms are about level with the floor, then press up

text.zh: 推到顶手肘伸直、肩膀往下压，停一下。
text.en: At the top, straighten your elbows, press your shoulders down and pause.
Keep your knees bent and do not swing your legs.

commonErrors.en: Going too deep and letting your shoulders roll forward.

cautions.zh: 肩膀不舒服时先只做顶端撑住，再慢慢加深
cautions.en: If your shoulders feel uncomfortable, start with top holds and only go as deep as is pain-free.

changes: 节奏按 spec：下 1.3 s / 底 0.2 s / 推起 1.3 s / 顶端压肩停 1.2 s（rest 段）
口令重排：原 peak「推起」end「锁肘停住」错位 → 慢慢下去 → 推起来
主口令补上「再推起」；cautions 改短句
flags: 批表 d 轨 go/back 1.07 与 spec 1.3 s 不符，按 spec 手算
